gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-encode-sans-expa: Encode Sans Expanded keeps its c shapes with the tips pulled well apart, friendly and wide. Encode Sans Expanded carries a long page without fuss, while Balsamiq Sans up top stays bold and expressive.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-encode-sans-sc: Encode Sans SC finishes its terminals with a shallow curl and a wide gap, businesslike but never stiff. Balsamiq Sans is the one for expressive, bold display lettering, while Encode Sans SC does the quiet sans-serif work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-encode-sans-semi: Modern and approachable, with an open counter on the s that keeps each word easy to catch. Encode Sans Semi Condensed would carry a long stretch of text comfortably, under a Balsamiq Sans heading drawn like bent wire.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-exo: Balsamiq Sans draws every stroke at one weight, bold and expressive. Exo follows with wide gaps that keep tiny sizes crisp, so a long stretch of sans-serif text stays friendly and clean.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-exo-2: Clean and professional, with curves holding plenty of daylight inside them. Exo 2 is the one for steady text, whereas Balsamiq Sans, with letters that look cut from wire, is the one for bold, expressive headings.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-faculty-glyphic: Faculty Glyphic gives its rounded letters clear openings, modern and businesslike in sans form. And Balsamiq Sans, with diagonals as heavy as its verticals, hands over to it gently, so a long read keeps moving.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fahkwang: Fahkwang reads contemporary and friendly, with faint nib pressure in its round letters. Balsamiq Sans is best at bold, expressive headings whose arches match their stems, while Fahkwang does the gentler work of finishing its curves early for text.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-figtree: Figtree looks drawn with a marker tip, its e left with a wide gap. Together the strongest quality is a shared friendliness: Balsamiq Sans shouts boldly, and Figtree keeps the modern sans text relaxed beneath it.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-finlandica: Balsamiq Sans is bold and expressive, its line never pinching into tight curves. Finlandica gives e crossbars open mouths and an outline you could trace with a finger, so sans-serif paragraphs go down clean and easy.
gen-gf-balsamiq-sans-gf-fustat: Balsamiq Sans has a line like a stencil-cut channel, constant and bold. Make that heading small, though, and Fustat's rope-like lines with a wide gap where the c ends would quickly outshine it as plain sans text.
